message.text: Checking helpers.go and render.go to confirm the filter parsing mechanism. Proto comments mention CEL.

The engine is CEL (Common Expression Language) via google/cel-go. It lives in internal/filter.

It compiles CEL to a dialect-agnostic condition tree. SQL per dialect is rendered via AppendConditions and CompileToStatement.

q25.
CEL Engine — internal/filter; CEL is compiled to a dialect-agnostic condition tree, then rendered to SQL via `AppendConditions`/`CompileToStatement` with `DialectSQLite`/`DialectMySQL`/`DialectPostgres`.

`ListMemosRequest.filter` is documented as a CEL expression in `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto`. `internal/filter.Engine` (`internal/filter/engine.go`, cel-go) parses it; each dialect driver (e.g. `store/db/sqlite/memo.go`) calls `filter.AppendConditions` in `internal/filter/helpers.go` to append the rendered SQL fragment and args.
